name: access-overview
title: 访问概览（健康成功请求除外）
query: request_id:* | SELECT count(*) AS requests, count_if(path='/' AND status=200) AS homepage_ok, approx_distinct(client_ip) AS distinct_ips, count_if(status>=500) AS server_errors, approx_percentile(duration*1000,0.95) AS p95_ms

name: access-trend
title: 每小时请求与错误
query: request_id:* | SELECT date_trunc('hour',__time__) AS time, count(*) AS requests, count_if(status>=500) AS server_errors GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

name: access-paths
title: 热门路径
query: request_id:* | SELECT path, count(*) AS requests, approx_percentile(duration*1000,0.95) AS p95_ms GROUP BY path ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20

name: access-status
title: 状态码
query: request_id:* | SELECT status, count(*) AS requests GROUP BY status ORDER BY requests DESC

name: access-sources
title: 来源域名
query: request_id:* | SELECT coalesce(nullif(referer_host,''),'直接／未知') AS source, count(*) AS requests GROUP BY source ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20

name: access-browsers
title: 浏览器（UA 粗略识别）
query: request_id:* | SELECT CASE WHEN user_agent LIKE '%Edg/%' THEN 'Edge' WHEN user_agent LIKE '%Firefox/%' THEN 'Firefox' WHEN user_agent LIKE '%Chrome/%' THEN 'Chrome' WHEN user_agent LIKE '%Safari/%' THEN 'Safari' ELSE '其他／未知' END AS browser, count(*) AS requests GROUP BY browser ORDER BY requests DESC

name: access-geo
title: IP 粗略国家／地区
query: request_id:* | SELECT CASE WHEN client_ip LIKE '%:%' THEN ipv6_to_country(client_ip) ELSE ip_to_country(client_ip) END AS country, count(*) AS requests GROUP BY country ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20

name: access-errors
title: HTTP 错误及请求 ID
query: status >= 400 | SELECT __time__,request_id,path,status,duration*1000 AS duration_ms ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 50

name: app-errors
title: 任务与应用异常
query: level:ERROR | SELECT __time__,event,request_id,job_id,provider_request_id,error_type,error_message,stack ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 50

name: app-tasks
title: 采集、AI、通知最近结果
query: event:* AND NOT event:http.request | SELECT __time__,event,job_id,collection_status,delivery_status,posts,provider_request_id ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 50

name: access-arrival
title: 访问日志入库时间与样本大小（估算，非账单）
query: request_id:* | SELECT max(__time__) AS latest_event_s, max("__tag__:__receive_time__") AS latest_ingestion_s, count(*) AS records, sum(length(path)+length(user_agent)+length(request_id)+length(client_ip)+128) AS estimated_payload_bytes

name: app-arrival
title: 业务日志入库时间与样本大小（估算，非账单）
query: * | SELECT max(__time__) AS latest_event_s, max("__tag__:__receive_time__") AS latest_ingestion_s, count(*) AS records, sum(length(MESSAGE)+128) AS estimated_payload_bytes

name: collector-buffer
title: 采集器磁盘缓冲（不含内存队列）
query: event:collector.health | SELECT __time__,collector_active,buffer_files,buffer_bytes,oldest_buffer_age_s,checkpoint_age_s ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 10
